items.title: Unit 2 · Story
items.scene: I ride my ___ at nine o'clock.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: I ride my bike at nine o'clock.
items.storyText: My name is Mike. I ride my bike at nine o'clock. I hike up to the pines at ten o'clock. I dive in the lake and swim in waves at five o'clock. It is time to wake up, Mike!
items.why: In “Wake Up, Mike!”, you hear: I ride my bike at nine o'clock. The missing word is “bike”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 3, Unit 2, p.19 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
